entry.title: Stand-up paddle boarding
entry.content:
Thursday, 24 September 2026, 7 – 8am



Bookings essential. Learn the basics of Stand-up paddle boarding. This lesson includes safety and awareness, paddle techniques and activity tips. A sun safe top will be provided.

This is a Chillout event suitable for young people 10-17 years.

Bookings: Bookings essential. To book visit Sunshine Coast Surf Schools. For more information phone Leighton on 0412 563 191.
Activity type: Adventure, Kids activities, School holidays, Water activities
Requirements: Towel, swimwear, sunscreen and water.
Age range: Kids, Teens
Age: 10-17 years old
Cost: $6
Event type: Fitness & well-being, School holidays
Venue: Bayside Park, Manly
Venue address: Bayside Park, 450 Esplanade, Manly
Venue type: Park
Meeting point: In the park, close to amenities block.

entry.title: Pilates
entry.content:
Thursday, 24 September 2026, 7 – 8am



Pilates helps you strengthen and stretch simultaneously through core-based exercises. Join anytime.

This is a GOLD event suitable for seniors.

Bookings: No bookings required. For more information phone Sharon from Precision Pilates on 0439 996 049.
Activity type: Mind and body
Requirements: Exercise mat and stretch band if you have one.
Age range: Seniors
Age: Seniors
Cost: Free

entry.title: Abseiling
entry.content:
Thursday, 24 September 2026, 7:30 – 9:30am



Bookings essential. Conquer your fears and experience the thrills of abseiling at Kangaroo Point under the safe instruction of qualified facilitators.

This is a Chillout event suitable for young people 10-17 years.

Bookings: Bookings essential. To book visit Pinnacle Sports. For more information phone Pinnacle Sports on 3368 3335.
Activity type: Adventure, Kids activities, School holidays
Requirements: Participants under 16 years of age must be accompanied by an adult for the duration of the activity.
Age range: Kids, Teens
Age: 10-17 years old
Cost: $6
Event type: Fitness & well-being, School holidays
Venue: Kangaroo Point Cliffs Park, Kangaroo Point
Venue address: Kangaroo Point Cliffs Park, 29 River Terrace, Kangaroo Point
Venue type: Park
Waterway access facilities: Canoe ramp, Single pontoon
Waterway access information: Kangaroo Point canoe ramp | Status: open, Naval Stores pontoon | Status: open,  
Meeting point: Scout Place, 200 River Terrace, Kangaroo Point. Look for Active & Healthy sign.
